name: Holt
title: Crofter
examine: Young enough to still wave at travelers. The dog ran off with a wolfkin pack in the autumn and he maintains it will come back.
lines: If you see a black-eared dog with the wolves — that's Biscuit. He's ours. Mostly.
The shrine down the road works. I don't know HOW it works. But you sit a minute and things weigh less.
Grandda says the towers on the old line used to talk with lamplight. Three flashes meant run.
